Birsa Munda Birth Anniversary: birsa munda ki 151vin jayanti par PM modi aur CM hemant soren ne kiya naman
Dharti aaba bhagvan birsa munda ki 151vin jayanti ke avsar par deshbhar men unhen shraddhanjli arpit ki gaee. pradhanmantri narendr modi, bijepi ke rashtriy adhyaksh nitin navin, jharkhand ke mukhyamantri hemant soren aur odisha ke rajyapal brajmohan ram ne unhen naman kiya.
